annotations.title: Dépistage gel des avoirs d'une personne morale (registre national des gels)

description: Screen a legal entity (company, association, public body) against the official French national asset-freeze register published by the Direction generale du Tresor (open data, Licence Ouverte 2.0), which lists the EU, UN and French national freezes. It does not cover US OFAC or UK lists. Give `nom` (2 to 200 characters), and/or `immatriculation` (3 to 40 characters: a SIREN with pays=FR, or any national registration number); `pays` (ISO alpha-2) is optional and filters and ranks the matches. Legal forms (SA, LLC, OOO, JSC, GmbH...) and word order are ignored. Returns resultat = correspondance_forte (same registration number, or exactly the same words as a name or alias), a_verifier (all the requested words, two at least, are contained in a longer name or alias) or aucune_correspondance, up to 10 matches (name, aliases, registration numbers, countries, sanctions regime and legal acts, EU and UN references, date of the oldest act), the register publication date, source and licence, the limits of the check and a signed Ed25519 attestation. Never a 'not sanctioned' statement: no match means no match among the legal entities of the register published at that date. Limits: natural persons are excluded by design, so a sole trader is not screened; only the Official Journal of the EU and published orders are authoritative; a match by name alone may be a homonym and must be verified. When to use another tool: for the identity, status and insolvency of a French company use verifier_entreprise, which also raises the GEL_AVOIRS_CORRESPONDANCE signal; for a foreign entity and its group use entite_lei. Errors (never charged): missing or invalid input is rejected before any payment request; the register not being loaded yet returns an error and is not settled. The register copy is local and refreshed every hour when DG Tresor publishes a new version; if it could not be confirmed for 7 days, fraicheur is degradee and registre.publieLe gives the real date. Payment: $0.02 per call via x402 (USDC on Base). No account or API key.

immatriculation.description: National registration number (3 to 40 characters; a valid SIREN when pays is FR).

nom.description: Company name (2 to 200 characters; legal forms such as SA, LLC or OOO are ignored). Give nom and/or immatriculation.

pays.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country (FR, RU, IR...): filters and ranks.
